book.name: MARCOS
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ MARCOS

content: Ja' Naj A Gadara Etnebil Yu Pena Espíritu
Jix ec' apnoj Jesús yetoj eb scuywom bey jun xa sk'axepal ja' mar, bey jun lugar chi yij Gadara.
Lalan yeltej Jesús yul barco, catu' jix apni jun winaj sc'atan, speto campo santo. Ja' jun winaj tu', ey oc pena espíritu yin.
Asan bey mujan eb camnaj caan naj. C'am mac chi tzaje spixon ey naj yetoj cadena.
Tx'ial el xa c'al jix c'al-le ey naj yetoj cadena, chi oc yin sk'ab c'al yin yajan. Pero coc' xa c'al chi yun toj ch'en stujon toj. C'am junoj chi tzaje tet.
Tobal k'inal, c'ualil c'al ak'balil chi ec'ab bey wonanlaj c'al bey campo santo. Chi el yaw. Chi smak'on yasoj sba yetoj ch'en.
Ja' yet jix yilontej yin Jesús naat to ey naj, jix yak'on yip naj stit sc'atan. Jix ey kaan naj sattaj Jesús yet jix apni.

Jix yalon Jesús tu' tet jaxca ti': —Jaach pena espíritu, elan yin naj ti', ẍi Jesús tet. Catu' jix a yaw yin ipal. Jix yalon jaxca ti': —¿Tzet ja walon ja wet win, jaach Jesús? Jaachti' Sc'aal jaach Dios, naj yel xa c'al miman yel oc apnoj. Yu wal dios e ach jin k'an an, manchej jin ja wetne, ẍi jun pena espíritu tu' tet Jesús.
Catu' jix sk'anlen el Jesús tet naj tu': —¿Tzet ja bi? ẍi Jesús tet naj. —Legión cu bi, yutol caw ec'al jon, ẍi wan pena espíritu tu' yin naj.
Caw jix oc tean yin Jesús, yet watx' c'am chi chejle el eb pena espíritu bey jun lugar tu' yu naj.
Ja' scawilal tu' ey jun wonan. Ey wan no' txitam lalan slowi.
Jix oc tean eb pena espíritu tu' yin Jesús. Jix yalon eb: —Chej jon can toj xol no' txitam tu', yet watx' jaxa yin no' chi cu oc can oj, ẍi eb tet naj.

Catu' jix cha'letoj eb yu Jesús tu' yin no'. Catu' jix el eb yin naj tu', ja' yin no' txitam tu' jix to can eb. Ey mi caab oj mil no' txitam tu'. Jix sk'ojon el sba no' sat pac'an bey chi low no' tu'. Jix ey apnoj no' xol ja' mar. Pilan jix jik'wi no' titu'.
Ja' eb naj ilom txitam, caw jix xiw a eb naj sic'lebil. Jix to eb el oj. Jix ec' yalon can el eb yul conob, c'al bey naatlaj el oj, yuxan ec'al ánima jix bet ilon tzet jix yun tu'.

Jix apni eb ánima bey ey ec' Jesús tu' xin, jix yilon oc eb yin naj bey jix el eb pena espíritu tu', chotan ec' naj titu'. Ey xa oc spichil naj, watx' xa sc'ul naj. Yu jun tu', caw jix xiw a eb ánima tu'.

Ja' eb jix ilon wan tzet yetal jix el yunen Jesús tu', ja' eb jix alon yab wan xa eb ánima tu'. Jix yal eb masanil tzet jix yun yin naj bey jix el eb pena espíritu tu', c'al tzet jix yun no' txitam tu'.
Yu c'al tu', jix oc tean eb ánima yin Jesús, tol chi el Jesús yul x'otx'al eb tu'.
Ja' yet jix octoj Jesús yul barco, ja' naj bey jix el eb pena espíritu tu', jix oc tean tet naj, tol chi to naj yetoj.

Pero ma cha'letoj naj yu Jesús yetoj, jix yalon tet naj jaxca ti': —Paxan bey ja na, catu' cha walon tet ja mam c'al tet eb ja wican jaxca ti': “Tumi jantaj xa tzet jix el yunen Dios win an, jix ok' sc'ul naj win an,” ja chi, ẍi Jesús tet naj.
Jix to naj tu', jix ec' yalon el naj bey wan conob yul yet Decápolis.
Jix yal el naj jantaj tzet jix el yunen Jesús yin naj, yuxan tuxa c'al jix q'uey a sc'ul ánima masanil.
Ja' Ix Scutz'in Naj Jairo Yetoj Ix Ix Jix Mitx'on Sti' Spichil Jesús
Jix lawi jun tu' xin, catu' jix pax ec' Jesús bey jun xa sk'axepal ja' mar bey speto ta' a'. Ja' yet jix ec' apnoj titu', ec'al ánima jix syamba pax sba yin junel xa.
Jix apni jun yaawil snail sculto eb Israel chi yij Jairo. Jix c'al yil yin Jesús, jix sbejon ey kaan sba sattaj.

Jix c'oli yoc tean yin Jesús, jix yalon tet jaxca ti': —Caw tuxa chi cam jun jin cutz'in an. Toon wetoj an, catu' chi to ja batxban oc ja k'ab yiban ix, yet watx' chi wa'xi can sc'ul ix catu' c'am chi cam ix, ẍi naj tet Jesús.
Catu' jix to Jesús yetoj naj. Ec'al ánima jix to yintaj, tuxa c'al chi witz'le xa c'al oc sba eb yin.
Ja' xol ánima tu', ey jun ix ix caw ya' ey sic'lebil, lacaweb xa jabil c'al c'oli yey s'ilal ix.
Ec'al eb anwam bey jix bet yetne sba ix. Pilan jix lawi can el tzet ey ix tet eb. Pero c'am nioj jix wa'xi sc'ul ix yu eb, ja' ti' yet, tol chi c'al a can.
Pero jix yab sk'umal Jesús ix. Jix sjitz'ontoj sba ix yintaj naj xol ánima tu'. Jix smitx'on sti' spichil naj ix.
Yutol jix sna' ix: “Asanne c'al jin mitx'on nioj sti' spichil naj, oj wa'xoj can jin c'ul,” ẍi ix.
Ja' yet jun txolan tu' jix oc tucna yey s'ilal ix. Jix yab swa'xi can sya'ilal ix tu'.

Jix yotajnen el Jesús tol ey mac jix wa'xi can yu yipal naj. Yuxan jix meltzotoj t'anan yintaj yilon xol ánima tu', jix sk'anlen tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Mac txequel jun jix mitx'on jin pichil ti'? ẍi naj tet eb.
Catu' jix yalon eb scuywom tu' tet naj jaxca ti': —Tol cha wila chi switz' oc sba ánima ja win, catu' chi to wal ja k'anlen pax oj mac jix mitx'on ja pichil, ẍi eb tet naj.
Pero ja' Jesús xin, jix ec' c'al t'anan oj xol eb seyoni, mac jun jix mitx'on spichil tu'.
Jal ix ix tu' xin, caw chi bilwi a ix yu xiw c'ulal. Yotaj ix, tol jix wa'xi can sc'ul ix yu, yuxan jix to ix sc'atan Jesús, jix ey kaan ix sattaj. Jix yalon ix masanil tet naj.
Catu' jix yalon naj tet ix jaxca ti': Txo ix, jix wa'xi ja c'ul yutol jix ja waoc ja c'ul win an. Paxan yin tzala c'ulal. Tol jix wa'xi ja c'ul yin jun ja ya'bilal ti', ẍi Jesús tet ix.

Lalan to yalon Jesús, catu' jix apni wan eb jix bet bey sna naj yaawil snail sculto eb Israel tu'. Jix yalon eb tet naj: —Ja' ix ja cutz'in ma'eal cam ix. Na'ba xa c'al mi chi to yetne sba naj Cuywam ti' to yiloni, ẍi eb tet naj.
Pero ja' yet jix yaben Jesús tzet jix yal eb tu', jix yalon tet naj yaawil snail sculto tu' jaxca ti': —Manchej jaach oc il. Asan tol cha waoc Dios yin ja c'ul, ẍi Jesús tet naj.
Jix lawi tu', c'am mac jix ẍa'toj yintaj. Asan Pedro yetoj Jacobo, yetoj Juan yuẍtaj Jacobo tu', asanne eb jix ẍa'toj yetoj.
Jix apni bey sna naj yaaw tu' xin, catu' jix yiloni caw chi ok' ánima. Caw chi wek'ek'i eb yel yaw.
Catu' jix octoj yul na tu', catu' jix yalon tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yuxan caw chex ok'i? Ja' ix unin ti', man camnaj oj ix, tu' c'al chi wey ix, ẍi naj tet eb.
Pero tu' c'al jix tzeele naj yu eb. Catu' jix ujtele eltej eb sti' na yu, catu' jix yi'on octoj smam c'al xutx ix unin tu'.
Jix oc mitx'an yin sk'ab ix, catu' jix yalon tet ix jaxca ti': —Talita cumi, ẍi. Chi yal yel oc apnoj: “Jaach unin, jain chi wal e ach an, aan waan oj.”
Jix a xa c'al waan ix yet jun txolan tu', catu' jix ec'ab ix. Lacaweb jabil xa sk'inal ix. Ja' jantaj eb ey ec' titu', caw jix q'uey a sc'ul eb.
Jix cam sc'ul Jesús yalon tet eb, tol manchej yal el jun ti' eb. Catu' jix chejle ak'le low ix tu'.

footnotes.text: Legión chi yal yel oc apnoj, tol ec'al. Legión sbi jun jun bulan soldado Romano. Sbisil jun jun bulan tu', oxeb mil, ma wajeb mil soldado.
Decápolis chi yal yel oc apnoj, “laoneb conob.”
Ja' wan k'ane ti' yin jun ti'e chi yij Arameo. Ja' ton yin jun tu' jix k'anab Jesús.
